notes.title: Final Showdown Update 5.0
notes.content:
Patch 5.0.0

-   Two brand-new cyberpunk tracks: Metropolis Skyrise & Metropolis Crossing.
-    Full Offline Mode: Race any time, no servers needed.
-    The Legacy Box: All past exclusive items are unlocked for every player.


To every Dasher who raced, gave feedback, created content, or just dropped in for the fun — thank you.
You’ve made Dash Dash World more than a VR racing game.
You made it a community. A memory. A world.

We’ll see you at the starting line, one more time. 💙
— The Dash Dash World Team

Crash - Fix crash error in Metropolis Skyrise.
